hook: Two people and six dogs were trapped in a flooded house.
narration: Two people and six dogs were stuck in this flooded house after Hurricane Florence.
A Coast Guard rescue swimmer from Air Station Atlantic City rode the cable down to them.
The water around the house was chest deep.
Under it were barbed wire fences, and on top floated beds of fire ants.
He loaded the dogs into the rescue basket and held them steady for the ride up.
The basket is a steel cage on one cable, [short pause] so even a scared dog can ride it up.
Then the people went up with their dogs.
outcome: One basket at a time, the crew lifted the people and their dogs out of the flood.
title: Six dogs trapped in a flooded house
description:
A Coast Guard rescue swimmer from Air Station Atlantic City worked to rescue two people and six dogs from a flooded home in North Carolina after Hurricane Florence, Sept. 19, 2018.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Chief Petty Officer Brad Fitzpatrick, Air Station Atlantic City, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/627901/coast-guard-air-station-atlantic-city-rescues-people-and-pets-during-hurricane-florence-response
